chapter: Search Chronicle: Audience with the Solitary King!
act_title: Search Chronicle: Audience with the Solitary King!

quests.title: Search Chronicle: Audience with the Solitary King!

dialogue.t: So we're here in the end...
When I became an adult, I finally understood why the Forest Watchers had made those faces they did...
*cough* But anyway, I gave it my best shot.
I also learned that you should never bring unprocessed Pyro Regisvine fruit near a Jadeplume Terrorshroom...
By the time I smelled something burning, it was already too late. Barely avoided drowning in the spores it poured forth.
It's easy to forget, sometimes, that Fungi are a completely different species from Shroomboars.
Anyway, speaking of which, they actually are a type of fungus, right?
That's right, and they taste especially delicious in soups.
But anyway, let's get back to today's challenge.
Well, I haven't figured out what to cook ye... Oh! Right, uh, you mean the "negotiations." Sorry.
Perhaps you've heard the story of the two Fontemer Aberrant overlords? It speaks of how the Millennial Pearl Seahorse is described as being "proud" and "noble."
By contrast, the Emperor of Fire and Iron seems to be a fierce, cruel being, strong but brutal.
And here Paimon thought you'd pick the tougher opponent. After all, wouldn't a stronger opponent make for a cooler story?
That is true, but the Emperor is a heavily-armored crab... While the other party's a seahorse that flies!

dialogue.sit: I wonder, would you call a flying seahorse a Pegasus instead?

dialogue.t: Wait, is that the question we should be asking right now?
Still, if I could only ride it, even once...
Well, sure then. Looks like you're sticking this one out to the end.
Well, we are here, aren't we? Surely we can't leave empty-handed? Anyway, let's head out once you're ready.

dialogue.sit: I've got other things to handle. See you in a bit.

quests.description: Although his plan to make new buddies is not going well, Ranjit seems unconcerned. Indeed, he is already preparing for the next challenge…
